There is a label on the front right of the machine with 'FM 8503' visible in photo 1 and photo 2.
The machine has a foot pedal, a power switch, and a ruler on the table.
The table has a white surface with a black tiled floor underneath.
The machine appears to be used, with some scuffs and dirt visible on the body.
A black thread spool is on the thread stand, and yellow scissors are placed on the table.
No power cord is visible in any photo, suggesting it may be plugged in or not shown.
